subject: general
question: The Home Rule League was established in India by Indian nationalist Bal Gangadhar Tilak and Indian independence leader _______ in September 1916 in Madras, with the objective of achieving self-government in India.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Annie Besant**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Annie Besant was a prominent British socialist, theosophist, women's rights activist, writer, orator, educationist, and philanthropist.
 
• She was closely associated with the Theosophical Society, an organization formed in 1875 to advance the spiritual principles and search for Truth known as Theosophy.
 
• Besant became the president of the Theosophical Society in 1907 and played a significant role in the spread of Theosophy in India and worldwide.
 
• Under her leadership, the Theosophical Society grew significantly and became a major spiritual and philosophical movement.
 
• She was also actively involved in Indian politics and was a prominent supporter of Indian self-rule.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Annie Besant was instrumental in the establishment of the Central Hindu College in Varanasi, which later became part of the Banaras Hindu University.
 
• She was a key figure in the Indian independence movement and became the first woman president of the Indian National Congress in 1917.
 
• Besant was known for her efforts in promoting education, social reform, and her fight for women's rights.
 
• Her work and contributions left a lasting impact on Indian society and the Theosophical movement globally.
